terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Runs the web UI (Vite, http://localhost:5173) and the API (Express, http://localhost:5174) together. Sources .env then .env.local (either written by the Vercel env pull in the start step, or added manually) so the API process receives REALYTICA_*/BLOB_* vars; .env.local wins on conflict, and it is a clean no-op when both are absent. Both files are gitignored. The Vite dev server proxies /api to the API.
